answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in escrow and keep it there for 4 epochs before its votes or answers count. A swarm of 1,000 fakes therefore freezes 500,000 tokens and waits a month of epochs, and splitting the ember of funding across many wallets changes nothing, because every wallet still posts its own full bond. A gale of cheap sign-ups simply stalls at the gate. An honest agent pays once, gets the bond back with its ivory badge after the wait, and keeps earning.
